svg.title: Diamond join
svg.desc: Financing asks for the rates path; Expression finds it running and joins it; one decision goes to both.

text.tspan: Financing and Expression both turn out to need the 2027 rates path. Financing asks first.
The new question is in the live graph the moment it's asked, before any work is done.
Expression looks before asking its own, finds Rates path running, and joins it.
Rates path now has two dependents. Its updates and its decision go to both.
One investigation and one decision, with two nodes resting on it: the diamond.
